name: skillscfo
stderr:
Usage: skillscfo [options] [command]

Search and install SkillsCFO finance skills for AI coding agents

Options:
  -V, --version             output the version number
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  login <key>               Save an API key so other commands can talk to
                            SkillsCFO
  search [options] [query]  Find finance skills in the SkillsCFO catalog
  add [options] <slug>      Install a skill and write its SKILL.md to the
                            chosen agent's skills directory
  start [options]           Answer a couple of questions, pick a skill, install
                            it — the guided version of search+add
  help [command]            display help for command
